rules.rule: npm run check's 'npx tsc --noEmit' type-checks zero files (root tsconfig files:[] + references, no -b). Until TM-B04 is done, a green check is not type-safety evidence.
E2E acceptance is run with --retries=0; playwright.config.ts retries:1 hides flakes.
On the GitHub runner Electron needs --no-sandbox (SUID sandbox helper not root/4755, apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1). Any C real-app launch passes it.

Clean-checkout simulation = rm -rf out test-results playwright-report tests/fixtures/*.wav, then the command; agents never run git clean -xfd or npm ci. Real npm ci evidence comes from the Actions run.
Independent readers: music-metadata decodes LIST/INFO as latin1 (Georgian UTF-8 becomes mojibake); for non-ASCII values compare against ffprobe and raw INFO bytes, and record which reader was used.
WAV fixtures used for writes must have a non-empty data chunk (node-taglib-sharp 6.0.1 cannot parse a data chunk that ends exactly at EOF with size 0, see TM-B05).

Saba froze only package.json version + build (electron-builder config); B freezes the whole package.json per round unless a task lists scripts as owned. src/preload/* frozen unless a round says otherwise.
